verdict.rationale: PostHog Workflows lets users define when a workflow triggers on the events and person properties they already send, then run steps such as delays, audience splits, message sends and PostHog actions. Realtime CDP destinations, including a generic webhook, fire as events arrive and can be filtered by event type, property or SQL. For AI-native use, Hog functions can be written by PostHog AI, and the MCP server exposes a Workflows tool family. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that event-triggered rules work reliably in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: You decide when a workflow is triggered, who it reaches, and what happens at each step – triggers, delays, audience splits, message sends, and PostHog actions.
As PostHog data arrives, you can export it immediately to other tools
Pipelines are built from Hog functions, which you can configure from a template, write yourself, or have PostHog AI write for you.
Create workflows that automate actions or send messages to your users.
